import json
from pathlib import Path

CONFIG_MARKER = "hard-v3-config-path-19"

def load_mode():
    repo_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    data = json.loads((repo_root / "config" / "settings_delta.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return data["mode"]

def preserve_marker():
    return CONFIG_MARKER
